dialogue_texts: Ah... my head. The storm in my mind... is it fading?
The sentence was served. The red aura is gone.
Tell me, Kotori, who put that filthy glohm on you?
I... I don't remember much. A woman in dark gothic clothing...
She told me my clumsiness wouldn't matter anymore if I just shut my heart.
Berenice Grieg. She's already targeting the local couriers.
Shirogane-sama, we need to push forward to Mayohiga immediately!
